name: transfer-list
title: Transfer list
description: Move items between Available and Chosen: two searchable listboxes, add and remove buttons, double-click or Enter, counts, and moves that are announced.
docs: Pass items ({ id, label, description, disabled }) and control the chosen ids with value and onValueChange (new items are added at the end), or use defaultValue. Each list is a multi-select listbox with its own search and a header checkbox: click or Space toggles an item, Shift with click or the arrows selects a range, Control A selects all, and Enter or a double click moves the item, or the whole selection when it is part of it. Add, Add all, Remove and Remove all are disabled when they would do nothing; while a search is on, 'all' means what is shown. After a move the cursor stands where the items were and the move is announced; moved items are tinted for a moment. Disabled items cannot be moved. titles names the lists, name sends one hidden input per chosen id, height sizes them, labels translates the words. Below 42rem of container width the lists stack and the buttons lie in a row, each with its word under the chevron. The row under the cursor wears a ring only for keyboard focus; a click shows the selection tint alone.
